name: Sawdust & Splinters LLC
old_description: Heirloom quality tables, benches, chairs, and matching furniture built around your space, style, and family.
about:
Sawdust & Splinters LLC operates from Sioux Falls, South Dakota, where it handcrafts custom dining tables, benches, chairs, and matching furniture. The workshop builds each piece to order, starting with the customer's space rather than a stock size chart.

The company works exclusively with solid hardwoods such as walnut, oak, alder, beech, maple, and white oak, offering a range of natural, stained, painted, and custom-matched finishes. Its process moves from a design consultation through detailed specifications for size, base style, wood species, and seating options, after which the project enters a production queue for handcrafted assembly and finishing in Sioux Falls.

The business serves homeowners and families seeking heirloom-quality dining furniture tailored to their specific rooms and usage patterns. Clients provide inspiration photos, dimensions, and material preferences, and the shop translates those into one-of-a-kind tables, benches, and chairs.

Sawdust & Splinters emphasizes that its pieces are built for real family life, combining quality joinery with finishes selected for durability and everyday practicality. The company also offers a line of cleaning and maintenance products formulated for its furniture.
